What this run shows about the strategy

Measured on this run's own baskets and fills; the numbers are in diagnostics.json.

1
93.5% of baskets win, and it needs 94.1% to break even
The average winner is $2.22, the average loser -$35.15: one average loss cancels 16 wins. The worst basket (-$1,820.77) cancels 821. The 10 worst baskets gave back 51% of everything the winners made. The margin over break-even is -0.6 points.
2
The ladder's big tiers fire together, at one price
35% of all ladder adds came within 3 seconds of the previous fill. By tier: M15 fired within 10 s of the add before it 85% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.28 per unit away); H1 fired within 10 s of the add before it 97% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.24 per unit away); H4 fired within 10 s of the add before it 100% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.24 per unit away). Those tiers carry most of the basket's size, so the 'averaging' is one large clip, not a ladder.
3
Full ladders: 90% win $11.88, the rest lose -$566.67
40 baskets reached all 6 positions; together they made -$1,838.99 (worst -$1,820.77). Baskets with no add made $4,251.36 in total; baskets with at least one add made -$5,039.60.
4
The slope exit closes losers near their worst price
67% of losing baskets were closed within 10% of the largest loss they ever showed. Losers were held a median 11 minutes (one in ten longer than 1.0 h, the longest 7.3 h); 28% of them had been in profit first. Winners were at worst -$1,002.81 under water before coming back.
5
Spread paid: $2,945.42
That is 39% of the gross profit of the winning baskets; before spread the run would have netted $2,157.18 instead of -$788.24. Median spread at entry: $0.26 per unit.

Where the money came from, and where it went

While flat the bot polled 3,663,103 times: the open score wanted a trade but the force-close score vetoed it on 25.7% of those polls, the re-entry cooldown blocked a ready signal on 26.3%, and the trading window on 1.4%. A ladder tier hit its RSI level but was held back by the open-score gate on 4,197 polls; 45,600 polls were spent holding a full ladder.
